verdict.rationale: 1Password explicitly documents Apple Watch support for quickly looking up saved information including one-time passwords, letting users read codes without pulling out their phone. This directly matches the story, though evidence is limited to Apple Watch (no mention of other smartwatch platforms like Wear OS) and lacks independent hands-on corroboration. Missing for 10: evidence of Android/Wear OS smartwatch support, independent user reviews confirming the watch OTP experience.
